summary: Focused re-test of BUG 1 only (seller listing deletion) on artirdim.com via Playwright against the public preview URL. RESULT: BUG 1 is FIXED. Logged in as seller@test.com, opened /seller/auctions/test-delete-DXPtMg (ACTIVE, owned by seller, id=19, not deleted before test), clicked [data-testid=delete-auction-btn], confirmed .swal2-confirm. No Inertia error modal / no 'plain JSON response was received'; the SPA redirected to /seller/auctions, the success flash 'Ilan kaldirildi.' rendered, and the deleted auction no longer appears in the list (counts dropped to 2 total / 1 draft / 1 active). Refreshing /seller/auctions loads cleanly (title 'artirdim | Ilan Yonetimi', no errors). Direct GET of the deleted auction detail correctly returns HTTP 404. No other bugs retested per request.

issues: Breadcrumb reads 'Admin / Ilanlar' on the seller listing page - should be 'Satici' (seller) context, not 'Admin'. Cosmetic/label bug, likely copied from the admin index page.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix in Seller\AuctionController@destroy (excluding Inertia via X-Inertia header before the wantsJson()/ajax() JSON branch) is correct and verified end-to-end.
Frontend delete still has no router.delete onError handler; any future non-Inertia/500 response would surface as a raw Inertia modal rather than a user-friendly message.

rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA (iteration_1): destroy() branched to JSON because request()->ajax() is true for Inertia requests (X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest), so Inertia received a plain JSON body and raised the error modal. The fix adds a `! request()->header('X-Inertia')` guard so Inertia requests fall through to redirect()->route('seller.auctions.index'). Verified working.
